data.rationale: The proposal has the right procedure and mostly the right parameters, since activity/topic plus state roughly covers filter_type/filter_values/state, but it combines the FIND A PARK and Search by Activity or Topic clicks into one step, leaves out the optional state-selection step even though state is listed as a parameter, and never links the vague 'Select an option' step to any parameter.
